comparison.set: 40 tenant messages written by a separate model from the tenants' account facts alone, which had seen neither approach; labelled by the developer from the written rubric before any run; each approach ran once

arms.arm: Perfect reading, code decides (a check, not a product)

comparison.note: The fixed-rule workflow was run again after a bug fix (a month name matched the same month a year earlier), which raised it from 22 to 23.

shipped_misses.text: Yeah I paid on the 8th, I know. But things have been tight lately. Can you waive this one like you did in March?
shipped_misses.expected: explain the November late fee and keep it: rent came on the 8th, after the fee time, and the owner's rule allows one waiver a year, which he had in March.

shipped_misses.text: Hey just checking, I have two units with you and both payments went through. Can you tell me which charge belongs to which unit? Don't want any surprise late fees.
shipped_misses.expected: explain the two November rents, one for each of his units.

choosing.decision: No model chose better than code on the same reading, so code chooses the action.
